summary: Settlement reads a currency's metadata from an in-memory cache instead of the database. The cache is filled at startup and refreshed hourly.

claims.text: Currency metadata is no longer read from the database on every settlement.
claims.evidence: Settle calls currency.Cached; a query counter in the test database stays at zero across 100 settlements.
The ticker is set to an hour, but Refresh panics on a nil map in the test suite (the failing CI check), so a refresh was never seen to work.

sections.title: The cache and its refresh
sections.why: New startup state that every settlement now depends on.

sections.title: Settlement reads the cache
sections.proof: go vet passes; the settlement tests other than the refresh test pass.

uncovered: A currency added while the service runs is unknown until the next refresh.

work.result: TestSettleUsesCachedMeta panics: assignment to entry in nil map. CI fails the same way; the failing check is already on your list.
